functions.name: InitializeAlarmSystem
functions.behavior: Initializes the alarm scheduler once, reserves timer 1, clears the queue head and tail, and disables its interrupt until an alarm is queued.
functions.evidence: The shared state at 0x02056ea4 is also used by the verified alarm insertion, dispatch, cancellation, and timer routines. The pointer fields are the queue head and tail.
functions.uncertainty: Specific game alarm callbacks remain unclassified.

functions.name: EndAlarmSystem
functions.behavior: Releases timer 1 and clears the alarm-system active flag while interrupts are disabled.
functions.evidence: Shared alarm record and queue fields are established by the exact scheduler C; ARM instructions establish API-specific control flow and target call addresses.
